Contact FN Squad

Joining and updates

Which WhatsApp group is the main one?

FreakyHomie is the main FN Squad WhatsApp group. Other group members can see your phone number.

Where do I follow announcements?

Follow the FreakyNews WhatsApp channel for news and FN Squad Updates for community announcements.

Minecraft

How do I join FN SMP?

Apply for the whitelist in Discord. The FN SMP joining guide shows where to apply and where to get the connection details.

FreakyNews

How do I correct a FreakyNews story?

Use the editorial contact and include the story link, what needs correction and a source if available.

Reports and privacy

How do I report bullying, a scam or unsafe behaviour?

Contact a moderator privately. The reporting guide explains what to include and what to redact.

How can I request access, correction or deletion of my data?

See privacy requests for the contact route and the information to include.

Bantuan dalam Bahasa Melayu

Gunakan direktori rasmi untuk menyertai komuniti. Untuk pertanyaan atau bantuan, gunakan saluran hubungan FN Squad.
